subjects.source: grade 4.pdf — विद्यार्थीको सिकाइ उपलब्धि मूल्याङ्कन अभिलेख पुस्तिका, कक्षा ४, English, pages 11–21
notes: Credit hours are from the book's GPA table (page 60): Nepali 5, English 5, Mathematics 5, Science 5, Social Studies 5, Health/Physical/Creative Arts 3, Local Subject 4 (32 in all). The book has no outcome pages for the Local Subject.
Each unit lists its learning outcome indicators under the language skills Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing; the skill is stored as the outcome's assessment area.
The book prints no working hours for English units.
Unit 2 prints "Expression Possession" and the cumulative record prints unit 15 as "Aggreging and disagreeing"; both are stored with corrected spelling.

subjects.source: grade 4.pdf — विद्यार्थीको सिकाइ उपलब्धि मूल्याङ्कन अभिलेख पुस्तिका, कक्षा ४, स्वास्थ्य, शारीरिक तथा सिर्जनात्मक कला, pages 48–59
notes: Credit hours are from the book's GPA table (page 60): Nepali 5, English 5, Mathematics 5, Science 5, Social Studies 5, Health/Physical/Creative Arts 3, Local Subject 4 (32 in all). The book has no outcome pages for the Local Subject.
Outcomes are printed in Nepali and English, with no content-area column.

Garbled English is rewritten from the Nepali where the printed text was wrong: theme 6 row 2 (drill commands), theme 7 row 2 (hop race), theme 10 rows 5–7, theme 11 rows 4 and 7, theme 12 rows 1–3 and 5, theme 13 rows 1–2 ("rhythm and rhythm" → "rhythm and beat"). Theme 6 title prints "Physucal".
